title: Cebu pours ₱38.25M into organic fertilizer for El Niño

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu Province is allocating ₱38.25 million for 51,000 bags of organic fertilizer, the largest allocation among seven agricultural inputs under its proposed Super El Niño Mitigation Plan. The amount accounts for more than 72 percent of the plan’s total ₱53.021-million budget, which is funded under the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office. The agricultural inputs are expected to be distributed in the latter part of this year.
